_: The Agents' wing: one office per specialist agent, in its own colours, with a door into its dashboard. Add your own here (lesson GS-09 and prompts/README.md, 'Put it in the office'). key: lower-case id. machine: the machine (workspace.config.json machines) it runs on. status: live, building or planned. door.local: its dashboard on that machine (opens only while it is running); door.phone: its tailnet address once tailscale serve publishes it (the office never proxies a dashboard). probe: a loopback port and path the office checks every 20 s to see whether it is running (any HTTP answer counts; never a path that hands out a login token). match: words that find its sessions on the floor by title or folder; only their count is shown. brand: its colours (bg, panel, ink, accent, accent2), a font, and an optional mark (an image under public/agents/); with no mark its first letter is drawn.
